info.title: Parcel Express API
info.description:
* # Parcel Express API Documentation
 * 
 * This API provides comprehensive parcel management and logistics operations for the Parcel Express system.
 * 
 * ## Authentication
 * 
 * This API uses Laravel Sanctum for authentication. To authenticate:
 * 
 * 1. Use the `/api/login` endpoint to obtain an access token
 * 2. Include the token in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer {your-token}`
 * 3. For multi-tenant operations, also include workspace headers:
 *    - `X-Workspace-Key`: Encrypted workspace ID
 *    - `X-Workspace-Type`: Workspace model class
 * 
 * ## Response Format
 * 
 * All API responses follow a consistent format:
 * 
 * ```json
 * {
 *   'success': boolean,
 *   'message': string,
 *   'data': object|array,
 *   'errors': array
 * }
 * ```
 * 
 * ## Rate Limiting
 * 
 * API requests are rate-limited per user. If you exceed the limit, you'll receive a 429 status code.
 * 
 * ## Error Handling
 * 
 * The API uses standard HTTP status codes:
 * - 200: Success
 * - 400: Bad Request
 * - 401: Unauthorized
 * - 403: Forbidden
 * - 404: Not Found
 * - 422: Validation Error
 * - 500: Internal Server Error
 *
